data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 – refund of €888
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterstadt-Nord issued the income tax and solidarity surcharge assessment for 2025 on 27 April 2026. It results in a refund of €888.00 to your bank account.
data.explanation: Your 2025 tax assessment is final (not provisional) and shows a refund (Erstattung) of €888.00, which will be transferred to the account named in the letter. The home office costs were only accepted as the flat rate (Homeoffice-Pauschale), not as a full home study deduction. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the tax office; the app shows until when. Keep the notice safe. A tax adviser can help if you want to contest it.
